tmc_navigation_source: ASP 3-D TMC DTM to NASA LOLA 120 m, independently corroborated by TMC ortho versus LOLA hillshade; local horizontal affine and vertical plane in tmc_navigation_affine.json
camera_source: OHRC IK/SPICE CK/SPK with 162.1 microsecond line cadence
pointing_prior_training_source: Mean of SIFT/AKAZE centre residuals on two previously observed OHRC ROIs, from pointing_residual_accounting.json
output_grid: nominal TMC-2 ortho polar stereographic 5 m; ground rays use aligned terrain and are converted back through inverse TMC navigation affine
decision: Candidate prior only; do not mark REGISTERED unless both geometry and untouched image/cycle evidence pass. 120 m LOLA alignment does not establish 5 m absolute accuracy.
